About the job

Description

We are looking for a Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager for the Amazon Mexico business to drive growth for the Amazon Mexico Stores via automated (performance) marketing channels.

We are looking for a marketing leader who likes to use technology to improve the customer experience and make a meaningful difference to how our customers shop online. At Amazon, we aim to become Earth’s most Customer-Centric Company and continue to innovate the way we engage with our customers through various marketing programs.

Critical missions of Paid Social and Creators team in Mexico are 1) to drive traffic and create innovative marketing programs in existing channels to make Amazon the most preferred shopping and entertainment destination for customers in Mexico, 2) to provide the best-in-class customer experience with highly personalized engaging marketing programs to help our customers make purchasing decisions, 3) to educate and attract new customers to Amazon overall and specific offerings, and 4) to dive deep into data to gain insights and optimize marketing programs.

The Sr. Social and Creators Product Manager plays a critical role in realizing these missions, leading various online marketing functions for Amazon.com.mx, managing and improving the marketing programs in Social Media Advertising and Creators Marketing. They will also be responsible for driving innovation by owning internally developed automated marketing products and platforms by leveraging the Amazon’s technologies. This position is one of the key senior roles in the Mexico Marketing and Prime organization. The impact of this role is significant, accounting for a large percentage of all amazon.com.mx new customers, traffic and sales. The position reports to the Head of Automated Marketing for Amazon Mexico.

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:
About the job

Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead
About Flowerburst

We are the fastest growing and most disruptive business in publishing since Amazon. 




Flowerburst starts movements — ideas that burst into life radiantly. Publishing is broken: more than 80 percent of Americans feel they have a book in them, and only about 1 percent ever publish it. After taking 2-3 years to go to market, nine out of ten traditionally published titles fail to turn a profit. Why? There are three middle men between the author and end customer, and there simply isn’t enough margin for any party to invest in marketing. 




Success on self-publishing platforms like Amazon KDP is even more elusive – they leave authors marketing blind and without cashflow: Amazon KDP doesn't show authors who their customers are and where they came from, and pay 60+ days after a sale is made. The result is centuries of gatekeeping in which the best ideas rarely reach the people who need them, dying on shelves in the back of bookstores, undiscovered. We are building the company that fixes this: an AI publishing platform fused with social, direct-to-consumer commerce. The AI platform allows anyone, anywhere to compile their idea in book form - helping the author exactly where they need it. Social commerce allows authors to place books in the heart of culture – social media feeds – to get discovered, even by audiences who typically don’t read books. Anyone, anywhere can write a book and get it to the masses. The end goal is a literary revolution.




The flywheel is already turning and validation has been immediate. In under 12 months since prototype launch, we’ve grown to $7.5M ARR (GMV run rate), and we are one of the top book sellers on social commerce platforms like TikTok Shop; we operate our own publishing imprints, and a creator/affiliate program of hundreds of active creators. Over the next quarter, we’re releasing our own titles (we publish at the speed of movements, not years), and within the next year, we’re opening up our platform so any author – regardless of station in life – can put their idea on paper and bring it to people who are eager to hear it.




The team is scrappy, ambitious, fast-moving, and highly entrepreneurial.




About the Role

We are hiring a Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead to own and scale one of the most important parts of Flowerburst’s growth engine: our TikTok Shop affiliate and VIP Special Ops creator program.




This is not ordinary affiliate management.




Flowerburst has access to a large catalog of top-selling books and uses performance data to identify products with viral TikTok Shop potential before the broader market fully catches on. When we find those products, we bring them to selected creators with a compelling offer: higher commissions, product insights, performance analysis, content hooks, sample support, GMV Max support, and a real partnership designed to help them grow their GMV.




The goal is to help creators win. When creators consistently post around the right products, the upside can be substantial for both the creator and Flowerburst.




You will manage relationships with top TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators, convert them into active VIP partners, and help them produce more videos that sell books. You will be responsible for turning creator interest into posting commitments, repeat content, GMV growth, and long-term creator partnerships.




This is a creator-facing growth role for someone who is organized, persuasive, commercially minded, and excited to help build a repeatable creator revenue engine.




What You’ll Do

You will manage Flowerburst’s VIP creator pipeline from outreach to activation.




This includes identifying promising creators, sending personalized outreach, following up, tracking next steps, coordinating samples, sharing product briefs, asking for posting commitments, monitoring creator activity, and reporting what is working.




You will help build creator launch pods around new book releases and high-potential VIP products. For each campaign, you will help match the right creators with the right products, share content angles, track sample delivery and first posts, and encourage creators to post multiple videos rather than just one.




You will build relationships with creators so they see Flowerburst as one of their best affiliate partners. You will give them useful product insights, help them understand why certain books may resonate with their audiences, and make them feel like part of an insider program.




You will also help build the operating system behind the program: clean tracking, weekly reporting, repeatable follow-up workflows, creator briefs, and simple SOPs.




Responsibilities
Manage a pipeline of TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators
Invite high-potential creators into Flowerburst’s VIP Special Ops Program
Send warm, persuasive, personalized outreach and follow-up messages
Clearly explain the creator opportunity and why selected products may help creators grow GMV
Track creator status, next steps, samples, posting commitments, and performance
Coordinate with internal operations on creator samples
Help creators understand which books to post and what angles may work
Build and manage creator launch pods for new book releases and VIP products
Ask creators for specific posting commitments
Track first post date, number of videos posted, repeat posting, and GMV
Re-engage creators who have sampled from Flowerburst in the past
Report weekly on creator pipeline, activity, and performance
Identify which creators, products, and content angles deserve more investment
Improve outreach, follow-up, campaign briefs, and creator management workflows




What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will learn Flowerburst’s products, creator program, and TikTok Shop affiliate workflow. You will understand the VIP Special Ops pitch deeply enough to explain it clearly to creators. You will clean up the creator tracker, follow up with warm creator leads, make sure every creator has a clear status and next action, help launch active creator pods, and establish weekly reporting.




You will also build a repeatable workflow for creator outreach, onboarding, follow-up, and campaign management. You will increase the number of VIP creators actively posting, track sample-to-post and post-to-GMV performance, help creators post multiple videos per campaign, own creator follow-up with minimal founder involvement, and create reusable creator briefs and campaign templates.




In your first 60 days, you will own the VIP creator program day-to-day, manage multiple creator launch pods, improve creator activation and repeat posting rates, and give leadership clear reporting on what is working.




In your first 90 days, you will help turn Flowerburst’s creator program into a predictable launch channel for new books and high-potential VIP products.




You Might Be a Fit If
You write excellent English
You communicate in a tone that is warm, casual, direct, and professional
You are highly organized and detail-oriented
You follow up consistently without needing reminders
You are comfortable managing many conversations at once
You have experience in creator partnerships, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, account management, sales development, customer success, ecommerce, or partnerships
You are comfortable using spreadsheets, Airtable, Notion, HubSpot, or similar tools
You can work independently and take ownership
You are comfortable asking people for commitments and following up when they do not deliver
You can understand performance data and translate it into simple, compelling creator-facing communication
You are interested in TikTok, creators, social commerce, books, media, or ecommerce




Bonus Points
Experience with TikTok Shop
Experience with influencer or affiliate programs
Experience working with U.S.-based creators
Experience in ecommerce or social commerce
Experience managing launch campaigns
Experience creating creator briefs or campaign briefs
Familiarity with BookTok, publishing, books, or media
Experience in a fast-moving startup environment
Experience with Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center, affiliate platforms, or creator CRM tools




Location and Schedule

This is a full-time remote role.

We are equally interested in candidates based in South Africa, LATAM, and the Philippines.

You must be able to communicate with U.S.-based TikTok creators and affiliates during meaningful U.S. business-hour overlap, especially Eastern and Pacific afternoons.




Compensation

Expected base compensation:

$2,500–$3,500/month USD
Up to $4,000/month USD for an exceptional candidate




There is also significant performance bonus potential for measurable GMV growth.




This role has meaningful upside for the right person. If you help Flowerburst activate strong creators, increase repeat posting, and materially grow GMV from managed creator relationships, we want you to share in that success.




The bonus structure will be finalized after baseline performance and attribution are clear, but it will be tied to outcomes such as creator activation, videos posted, repeat posting, and incremental GMV from managed creators.




What We’re Looking For

We are not looking for a generic virtual assistant.




We are looking for someone who feels like a high-performing account manager, creator partnerships operator, or affiliate growth manager. You should be proactive, commercially minded, organized, and excellent in written communication.




The goal is not just to send messages. The goal is to turn creator relationships into videos, repeat posting, GMV, and long-term creator partnerships.




The right person should be excited about the opportunity Flowerburst can offer creators. We are bringing creators data-backed product opportunities, improved economics, performance support, and a real chance to grow their GMV.

Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients' lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.

Job Summary

The Brand Lead, Hematology is a strategic and executional leader responsible for driving the commercialization of Reblozyl (Luspatercept) and support for the next launches in Cell Therapy in the market. This individual will develop and implement integrated brand strategies that reflect a deep understanding of the public and private healthcare market dynamics, including specialty and high-complexity treatment settings. As part of the BMS Hematology Commercial team, this role plays a pivotal part in ensuring speed to patients, cross-functional alignment, and business excellence in a highly competitive therapeutic landscape.

Job Description

The Brand Lead reports to the Franchise Lead, Hematology, and serves as the brand strategy owner for the hematology portfolio and supports the launch of Cell Therapies. This individual will be the orchestrator of a cross-functional brand team, translating scientific and clinical evidence into compelling commercial strategies that resonate with hematologists, multidisciplinary teams, and healthcare institutions across both public (institutional/government) and private market segments.

We are seeking a results-driven, patient-centered professional, passionate about hematology and experienced in specialty/high-complexity product management, who brings strong strategic acumen, executional discipline, and proven launch excellence capabilities aligned with the BMS Commercialization Model.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Commercialization


Lead the development and execution of the annual brand plan for Reblozyl and Cell Therapies, including situation analysis, strategic imperatives, tactical mix, and investment allocation.
Define and manage the brand positioning, messaging architecture, and value proposition for Reblozyl and Cell Therapies across all customer segments.
Drive Reblozyl and Cell Therapies launch readiness and execution, coordinating all pre-launch and launch activities across commercial, medical, market access, regulatory, and supply functions.
Develop and monitor brand performance KPIs, adjusting strategies and tactics based on market insights and competitive intelligence.
Digital Innovation & Omnichannel Excellence: Proven ability to lead integrated omnichannel campaigns that seamlessly connect field force, digital, and medical channels to deliver a consistent and impactful brand experience; hands-on experience applying Artificial Intelligence and advanced analytics tools to anticipate market trends, improve customer segmentation, and drive data-informed commercial decisions in specialty hematology.

Lead market research and analytics initiatives to generate deep understanding of the hematology landscape, unmet needs, patient journey, and stakeholder dynamics.
Map and analyze public market (IMSS, ISSSTE, IMSS Bienestar) dynamics, formulary processes, institutional protocols, and purchasing cycles.
Monitor private market dynamics including managed care, hematology networks, key hematology centers, and high-specialty hospitals.
Integrate insights from field-based teams, medical affairs, and market access to continuously evolve brand strategies.

Collaborate with Market Access to develop value-based tools and evidence strategies for institutional access (public tenders, CBNSS inclusion).
Work closely with the global brand team to align local strategy with global brand direction.


Launch Excellence


Own and drive the Hematology pipeline launch plan, from pre-launch readiness assessment to first patient use and post-launch tracking.
Lead development of launch promotional tools, training materials, and go-to-market plans for Hematology pipeline across public and private channels.
Orchestrate cross-functional launch readiness reviews (LRR) and milestone tracking.
Develop and monitor launch KPIs and adapt tactics as needed to ensure a successful market entry.


Operational Excellence & Compliance


Ensure all brand activities are executed in full compliance with BMS policies, local regulations, and industry codes (COFEPRIS, Código de Ética de la Industria Farmacéutica).
Manage brand budget with accountability, ensuring resource allocation maximizes ROI and strategic priorities.
Responsible of business planning cycles (P1, P2, P3, Budget, LRP) with accurate forecasting and strategic narrative.

Bachelor's degree required in Life Sciences, Business Administration, or related field
MBA or advanced degree strongly preferred


Experience

At least 3 years in hematology marketing or brand management in specialty/high-complexity settings
Proven track record of successful product launch execution (pre-launch through steady state)
Demonstrated expertise in public market (institutional) strategy and access dynamics
Experience managing brands in private market including HMOs, hematology

We are looking for an experienced Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our client, a growing international group operating across advisory services, real estate, travel assistance, and alternative risk solutions covering Latin America, Caribbean and United States markets.




This is a high-impact role focused on qualified lead generation, strategic partnerships and commercial opportunity development, working directly with senior executives and subject matter experts. The position requires a commercially mature professional who can open doors, build relationships, qualify opportunities and create a strong pipeline of high-value conversations.




What will you do




Identify, research and engage high-potential prospects across Latin America, the Caribbean and the United States.
Generate qualified business opportunities through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, events, webinars and strategic partnerships.
Conduct discovery conversations to understand client needs, decision-making structures, budget, timing and commercial potential.
Build and nurture long-term relationships with investors, business owners, brokers, advisors, agencies, and other key stakeholders.
Manage consistent follow-up activities to move prospects through the commercial pipeline and maintain engagement until handover or closure.
Schedule and coordinate meetings between qualified prospects and the appropriate business executive.
Maintain accurate CRM records, track pipeline activity and provide regular reporting on lead quality, conversion progress, and commercial opportunities.
Contribute ideas and market insights to help develop new commercial initiatives, partnerships, products, and go-to-market strategies.
Support the planning and execution of webinars, private events, and targeted outreach campaigns to generate qualified leads.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across the group's different business lines and markets.
Collaborate closely with management to achieve quarterly pipeline and opportunity-generation objectives.




What we are looking for




Fully bilingual English and Spanish.
Minimum 3 years of experience in business development, sales, lead generation, or strategic partnerships.
Proven experience engaging business owners, executives, investors, advisors, and decision-makers.
Strong prospecting, qualification, and relationship-management skills.
Comfortable working in an international and consultative sales environment.
Experience in professional services, financial services, insurance, reinsurance, real estate, relocation services, travel assistance, or B2B partnerships is highly valued.
Strong knowledge of CRM platforms and B2B prospecting tools.




Main skills 




Excellent communication, networking and relationship-building skills.
Strong commercial acumen with a results-oriented mindset.
Proven ability to identify, develop and qualify business opportunities.
Strategic thinking with the ability to build long-term partnerships.
Strong organizational, follow-up and pipeline management skills.
Strong attention to detail and an analytical approach to decision-making and problem-solving.
Resilient, proactive, and comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Customer-focused approach with confidence engaging senior executives and key decision-makers.
High level of autonomy, ownership, and accountability.




What success looks like 




This is not a high-volume sales role. Success is measured by the quality of opportunities generated, the strength of strategic relationships developed, and the contribution to a sustainable commercial pipeline across multiple business lines.




The role offers a clear path for professional growth, with opportunities to take on greater commercial responsibility over time.




What we offer




Exposure to international clients, partners, and business opportunities.
Direct collaboration with senior executives and industry specialists.
Opportunity to contribute across business development, marketing, operations, and technology initiatives.
Diverse and dynamic commercial environment spanning multiple industries and markets.
Performance-driven culture with clear opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
Competitive compensation structure with performance-based incentives.
Flexible remote working arrangement with the possibility to be located anywhere around LATAM.
Independent contractor agreement with long-term growth potential.




If you are a proactive, relationship-driven business development professional who thrives on creating opportunities and building strategic partnerships, we would be pleased to hear from you.




Please apply via LinkedIn with your CV and a brief summary of your relevant experience. All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality and in accordance with equal opportunity principles.

description:
About the job

Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $510,000 - $612,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $510,000 - $587,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes.

Working Within Our Values:

At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You’re responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.
Client: Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.
People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.
Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation.
Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. 


Qualifications


You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).
You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level.
You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools.
You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals.
You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables.
You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you'll do

In this role, you will implement and manage User Policy operational processes that support responsible market growth and instill trust among users and partners. You will assess risks and opportunities, liaise with financial partners and merchants, and manage escalations while providing timely responses. As a User Policy Specialist at Stripe, you will apply and enforce the rules and requirements that determine which businesses can use our platform. This role is closely aligned with Stripe's mission, as it involves making key decisions about business eligibility to access our economic infrastructure.

Responsibilities


Assess and identify potential risks associated with business partnerships, making informed decisions that balance opportunity with compliance to protect Stripe's brand and reputation.
Investigate, action, and triage escalations across multiple channels, while providing accurate and timely responses to stakeholders.
Collaborate with various stakeholders, including business units, legal teams, and financial partners, to communicate User Policy requirements and ensure alignment with Stripe's mission and value proposition.
Utilize analytics to optimize strategies that can be enforced across Stripe's portfolio.
Develop and implement User Policy operational processes that ensure compliance with internal rules and external regulations, thereby enabling responsible business growth and market expansion for Stripe.
Identify gaps and areas for improvement within current User Policy frameworks, recommending enhancements to support sustainable business practices and progressive growth.
Participate in periodic business reviews to evaluate the impact of User Policy on Stripe's market performance and contribute to strategic discussions aimed at enhancing Stripe's growth and reputation.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You possess experience in risk analysis, investigations, or risk operations
You have excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in diagnostic thinking and problem-solving, with experience using data to make assessments and judgments
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners



Preferred Qualifications


Risk experience in payments, e-commerce, or fintech mitigating digital and card-not-present risk
Experience in Trust and Safety related roles
Knowledge of risk schemes, risk prevention methods, and risk detection tools
Prior risk experience across multiple industries and verticals
Experience in a high-growth technology company
Experience working from a queue



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

title: Power BI Developer
description:

Through mentorship, certification opportunities when applicable, and continuous learning, we support our associates in reaching their professional goals. Whether your aspirations involve deepening your technical expertise, expanding your project responsibilities, or pursuing future growth opportunities, Impact Advisors Mexico provides the resources and support to help you succeed.

title: Fleet Acquisition Supervisor
description:
About the job

En PartRunner conectamos a las empresas que mueven mercancía de gran volumen con la capacidad de transporte que lo hace posible. Nuestra red integra flotas PyME y transportistas independientes en distintos puntos de México, con unidades que van desde vehículos ligeros hasta carga pesada.




Hoy el reto es construir capacidad instalada en los mercados correctos, con un equipo que replique el método en varias plazas al mismo tiempo.

Por eso buscamos un/a Fleet Acquisition Supervisor que construya la capacidad de transporte para una de nuestras cuentas de mayor volumen: una operación de e-commerce a escala nacional, con estándares de servicio altos y crecimiento sostenido.

Vas a dirigir a un equipo de negociadores regionales, cerrar las cuentas de mayor peso y construir la capacidad antes de que la demanda la pida.




El desafío

Este no es un rol de gestión de proveedores ni de administración de equipo a distancia. Es comercial, con responsabilidad sobre la capacidad de toda la red.

Del otro lado hay una cuenta que no espera. Cuando la demanda sube, la capacidad tiene que estar. Tu trabajo es que el equipo la construya con anticipación, no con urgencia, y que lo que funciona en una plaza se vuelva método replicable en las demás.




Lo que harás

1. Liderazgo y Desarrollo del Equipo Comercial

Supervisar, coordinar y desarrollar al equipo de negociadores regionales.

Asignar territorios, metas y prioridades según el déficit de capacidad de cada mercado.

Realizar sesiones semanales de pipeline review: avance por etapa, calidad de prospección y riesgos de cierre.

Detectar brechas de desempeño e implementar planes de desarrollo con objetivos observables.

Ser el primer nivel de escalación en negociaciones complejas o condiciones fuera de estándar.




2. Estrategia de Cobertura y Crecimiento de Red

Traducir la demanda proyectada de la cuenta en objetivos concretos de adquisición: cuántas unidades, de qué tipo, en qué ciudad y para cuándo.

Anticipar picos estacionales y campañas, asegurando capacidad disponible antes de que se necesite.

Priorizar plazas y segmentos de flota según el déficit real de capacidad, no según facilidad de cierre.

Diseñar y estandarizar el método de prospección para que sea replicable por cualquier integrante del equipo.

Abrir nuevos canales de captación y medir su rendimiento contra los existentes.




3. Ejecución Comercial Directa

Gestionar personalmente la negociación con flotas de alto volumen y contrapartes estratégicas.

Mantener cuota individual en las cuentas de mayor impacto para el negocio.

Acompañar a los negociadores en cierres críticos y en campo cuando el tamaño de la operación lo amerite.




4. Economics de la Red

Negociar y sostener condiciones que equilibren competitividad para el transportista y rentabilidad para PartRunner.

Monitorear el costo de adquisición por unidad activa y el tiempo entre cierre y primer viaje.

Identificar en qué plazas se está pagando de más por capacidad y proponer ajustes.




5. Enfoque Analítico y Digital

Monitorear indicadores de adquisición, activación y retención por plaza, tipo de unidad y canal.

Detectar patrones de churn de transportistas antes de que impacten la capacidad disponible.

Identificar tareas manuales del proceso de afiliación y traducirlas en requerimientos accionables para producto y sistemas.

Asegurar la disciplina de registro en CRM del equipo completo: sin dato, la etapa no existe.




6. Reporteo y Mejora Continua

Generar y presentar reportes semanales y mensuales por mercado con KPIs clave: unidades afiliadas · % activación · tiempo a primer viaje · costo de adquisición · % retención a 90 días.

Reportar el estado de capacidad frente a los compromisos de servicio de la cuenta, con alertas tempranas cuando un mercado vaya corto.

Presentar hallazgos e iniciativas a dirección de forma clara y basada en datos.

Realizar análisis post-mortem de plazas que no alcanzaron objetivo y proponer correcciones concretas.




Lo que necesitamos de ti

Must Have

3+ años de experiencia en adquisición, ventas o desarrollo de proveedores.

3+ años en transporte, logística, paquetería o marketplaces digitales.

1+ año liderando equipos comerciales, con responsabilidad sobre la meta del equipo y no solo la propia.

Experiencia negociando con flotas o transportistas de alto volumen.

Manejo de CRM y disciplina de gestión de pipeline, propia y de equipo.

Dominio intermedio-avanzado de Excel / Google Sheets y experiencia elaborando reportes ejecutivos.

Residir en Guadalajara o zona metropolitana.

Disponibilidad para viaje foráneo eventual a las plazas del equipo.




Nice to Have

Experiencia abriendo plazas o mercados nuevos desde cero.

Experiencia previa en startups o entornos de alto crecimiento.

Experiencia en prospección digital de fletes.

Manejo de herramientas de BI (Power BI, Looker, Google Data Studio).




Competencias Clave

Tomas decisiones rápidas con criterio y datos.

Alto nivel de seguimiento y cierre: no dejas hilos sueltos, ni tuyos ni del equipo.

Te autogestionas: en remoto y sin supervisión presencial, sostienes tu ritmo y el de tu equipo.

Curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA, y las usas para hacer más con menos.




Nuestra oferta de valor

Sueldo base competitivo + esquema de bonos por desempeño + prestaciones de ley y superiores + esquema 100% remoto. 




¿Listo/a para el reto?

Envía tu CV a f.castillo@partrunner.com o postúlate directamente por este medio.







En PartRunner promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y libre de discriminación. Todas las decisiones de nuestros procesos se basan en competencias, experiencia y potencial, sin distinción de género, edad, origen, orientación, identidad o cualquier otra condición.

About the job

Description

Are you passionate about music, entertainment, and building creative partnerships that drive growth at scale? Do you excel at identifying actionable insights that translate into strategic growth initiatives? Amazon Music is seeking a Senior Partner Growth Manager to lead and execute partnership growth strategies. This role will own the end-to-end partnership marketing lifecycle — from strategy through execution — working closely with internal teams and external partners to drive new audience growth, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention for Amazon Music.

For someone to be successful in this role, they need to embody the following:

Strategic Growth Leader: They must be a senior marketing professional with deep experience in partner-focused growth marketing or partnership marketing, able to define and drive the long-term vision for their portfolio of partnerships. They set strategy in ambiguous environments, handle complex problems, and use their expertise and judgment to design scalable solutions that deliver sustained business results.

Cross-Functional Influencer: They influence across external partners, internal teams, and geographies to deliver outcomes. They build consensus across diverse functions (Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Business Development) and present strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Relationship Builder: They excel at fostering and maintaining strong relationships across all levels — from C-suite executives at partner organizations to internal stakeholders — demonstrating exceptional communication skills and the ability to earn trust and influence.

Data-Driven Decision Maker: They have a natural curiosity for analytics and metrics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and compelling narratives that influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic decisions. They dive deep into performance data to identify trends, reduce churn, and optimize the full customer lifecycle.

Results Oriented & Operationally Excellent: They take ownership and drive initiatives from concept to completion at scale, mitigating long-term risks and making trade-offs between short and long-term needs. They model best practices, drive process improvements, and develop efficient, scalable mechanisms that ensure operational excellence and sustained growth impact.

Key job responsibilities


Define and execute the partner marketing and growth strategy for Amazon Music partners, delivering against customer acquisition, engagement, and retention goals
Own and execute the go-to-market of partner launches for growth marketing efforts, including ideation, planning, execution, analysis/reporting, and optimization
Continually optimize partnerships from launch through ongoing sustaining efforts to maximize offer discoverability, frequency in communications, share of voice and identifying new opportunities within existing partnership
Lead, implement, and launch partner campaigns with the North Star of delivering best-in-class creative excellence that represents the Amazon Music brand and drives awareness through partners
Dive deep into data to understand insights and learnings that drive strategy; lead performance management for partners and share market intelligence with stakeholders and teammates
Collaborate cross-functionally across Product, BI/Data Science, Marketing, Finance, Legal and Business Development to deliver best-in-class campaign opportunities and assets for partners
Develop efficient, scalable mechanisms that ensure operational efficiency of the team and maximize impact
Function at a global level, sharing best practices and scaling programs or campaigns that benefit multiple regions
Experiment with new approaches to drive partnership success and raise the bar on growth marketing innovation

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint
 Experience driving results through digital marketing and multi-channel campaigns
 Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
 Experience aggregating and analyzing internal and external campaign metrics to assess performance drivers and identify insights
 Experience communicating effectively with senior leadership
 Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks

 8+ years of experience in B2C partner-focused growth marketing or partnership marketing across industries such as music, entertainment, media, mobile, telecommunications, retail, or financial services

description:
About the job

Why this role exists




Charles, our founder, spends most of his week talking with the owners of short-term rental property management companies. Five or six of those conversations get recorded every week, and almost nobody sees them. Your job is to change that. You'll take everything he says on camera and turn it into the newsletter, clips, and posts that make him the best-known voice in this industry. He hits record and reviews your drafts once a week. Everything in between belongs to you.

About HostGenius




HostGenius is a private membership network and business operating system for short-term rental property management companies. More than 70 member companies managing about 3,000 properties run on our platform. Charles scaled his own property management company to 160 listings before starting HostGenius, so when he talks about this business, operators listen. We're profitable and growing fast, and this role turns his daily conversations into a growth channel.

What success looks like




A year from now, thousands of US property managers read our weekly newsletter. Clips go up on Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube every week, and every word sounds like Charles wrote it himself. He spends under two hours a week on content once the cameras are off. The sales team uses proof clips you found. The ads team runs creative you handed them. When we host an industry event, you stretch one week of recording into three months of material.




What you will own

Turning raw recordings into published content. You pick the moments worth keeping, cut clips with Riverside's Magic Clips, and write the hooks and captions.
Final copy for the weekly newsletter, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. Our AI pipeline produces first drafts for you. You run it, check it, and edit everything until it sounds like Charles.
The publishing calendar. Everything ships on time every week without anyone chasing you.
The weekly review with Charles. One approval pass. You ship what he approves and rework what he flags.
A weekly scoreboard: what shipped, newsletter growth, engagement from actual property managers, and which clips went to the ads team.
Freelance editors, once long-form YouTube outgrows Magic Clips. They cut, you direct.




Not in scope: paid ads (our Growth Marketing Manager owns Meta), long-form video editing (we will outsource it), and inventing strategy from scratch. The system is already designed. Your job is to run it every week and keep making it better.




What we are looking for




Required:

3+ years running content production end to end for a company, founder, or creator, with published work you can show us
Written English at a native level. You'll be ghostwriting a Canadian founder, and if your copy needs a second edit before it ships, this isn't your role. Finalists complete a paid writing test in his voice.
Good instincts for short-form video. You can listen to an hour of conversation and know which 40 seconds will stop someone scrolling.
The discipline to run a publishing calendar for months without missing a date
At least 4 hours of daily overlap with Pacific Time
You use AI tools daily for speed, and you catch what they get wrong




Nice to have:

Experience marketing to small business owners, or in real estate, hospitality, or short-term rentals
You've grown a newsletter on beehiiv, HubSpot, Kit, or similar
Podcast or webinar production, or familiarity with Riverside.fm
Enough design sense to make covers and carousels in Canva




Compensation

$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month as a full-time contractor plus up to a 30% annual bonus. This is a long-term role with upside as the media engine grows.




How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions. Make sure your resume or profile links to 2 or 3 pieces of content you personally produced. We read every application that includes work samples and skip the ones that don't. Finalists complete a short paid writing test.

description:
About the job

Reports to: Anna Sarelly, Founder & Creative Director

Location: Mexico City

Type: Full-time

Experience: 3+ years







ABOUT SARELLY

SARELLY is one of Mexico’s fastest-growing beauty brands, born at the intersection of beauty, culture, entertainment and community.




Founded by Anna Sarelly and Rémi Martini, SARELLY is building a new generation of beauty brand: culturally relevant, social-first and deeply connected to its community.

After becoming one of Mexico’s most exciting emerging beauty players, the brand is now entering its next chapter of growth, with major retail expansion across Mexico and the U.S.

Creativity is at the heart of everything we do—from product and packaging to campaigns, social content, retail experiences and entertainment. We are looking for someone who wants to help shape and protect a distinctive creative universe as SARELLY scales.







THE ROLE

SARELLY is looking for an Associate Art Director to ensure Anna Sarelly’s creative vision is consistently and flawlessly executed across every brand touchpoint. Reporting directly to Anna Sarelly, Founder & Creative Director, this person will work closely with her and with our Marketing and Creative teams, acting as the bridge between big-picture creative direction and day-to-day execution—translating campaign ideas into cohesive visual systems, guiding multidisciplinary teams, leading art direction, and ensuring everything we put into the world feels unmistakably SARELLY.




This is not a purely managerial role. We are looking for someone who can think, direct and make.

Someone with exceptional visual taste who can lead a shoot, ensure the vision is executed properly across different touchpoints, build moodboards, challenge layouts, guide designers, give meaningful feedback on social content, and step into execution when needed.

Most importantly, this role serves as the primary creative filter between Anna and the execution teams—protecting her time by determining what requires her input versus what can be independently resolved within established creative and brand standards.

Ultimately, your job is simple: Protect the creative vision from concept to execution.







WHAT YOU’LL DO

01 — Translate Creative Vision

Work directly with Anna to transform high-level campaign ideas, cultural insights and creative concepts into actionable visual direction.

You will help define and maintain consistency across:

Campaign visual systems
Art direction
Content pillars
Social expressions
Photography and video execution
Retail adaptations
Graphic design systems
Social media assets
Launch moments
Digital assets
Creator executions

You should be able to take a big idea and understand how it lives across an entire brand ecosystem—ensuring it remains visually coherent at every touchpoint.







02 — Lead Creative Execution

Own the execution of creative projects from briefing through final delivery.

Translate creative direction into clear, precise briefs for designers, photographers, videographers, editors, content creators, agencies, freelancers and brand creative production partners.

Ensure teams understand not only what they need to create, but why it matters to the overall vision.

Coordinate execution across multiple workstreams while maintaining consistency, quality and delivery timelines.







03 — Art Direct

Lead and support art direction across all brand outputs, including:

Campaign shoots
Social content shoots
Product photography
Video content
E-commerce visuals
Creator content
Brand activations
Retail experiences

You should feel comfortable making decisions around composition, lighting, styling, casting, props, sets, typography, motion and visual storytelling.

You will sometimes co-lead major campaigns with Anna and other times independently lead executions while maintaining full alignment with her vision.







04 — Own Creative Quality Control

Act as a guardian of the SARELLY visual universe.

Review creative output across teams and provide clear, actionable feedback before work reaches Anna.

This includes:

Social content
Reels / TikToks
Photography
Video edits
Graphic design
Campaign adaptations
Retail assets
Creator content
Digital assets
Brand presentations

Your responsibility is not simply to ask:

“Does this look good?”

It is to ask:

“Does this feel like SARELLY—and does it stay true to our creative vision?”

Act as the final creative checkpoint before work is escalated, ensuring Anna is only involved in decisions that genuinely require strategic creative direction.







05 — Lead Social & Content Execution

Partner closely with Social, Content, Growth and Market Pods to translate global campaign ideas into culturally relevant, platform-native executions.

Act as the primary creative interface between the Creative Studio and Growth teams, translating global creative direction into clear execution frameworks that allow local teams to execute autonomously while respecting SARELLY’s creative and brand guidelines.

The role provides creative direction and quality standards for social content but does not own the overall social media calendar, channel strategy or publishing cadence, which remain the responsibility of the relevant Social/Growth teams.

You will:

Refine visual consistency across social outputs
Improve execution of tone of voice, edits and formats
Identify opportunities for stronger visual storytelling
Maintain brand coherence in fast-moving content cycles
Ensure local market adaptations remain faithful to the global creative vision

Balance brand-building with the speed and spontaneity social requires.







06 — Strengthen the Creative Team Through Execution

Help raise the overall executional standard of the team.

Give clear, direct and constructive feedback focused on craft and consistency.

Mentor designers and content creatives in:

Layout
Composition
Visual hierarchy
Brand consistency
Execution quality

Create clarity when teams feel stuck and ensure the creative vision is understood and properly translated at every level.

Coordinate and prioritize work across Brand Design, Photo & Video, freelance creative resources and production partners, ensuring the right people are focused on the highest-impact work.

The goal is not for everything to depend on you.

The goal is to ensure the entire team executes at a higher standard.







07 — Own Creative Studio Operations

Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the Creative Studio.

You will be responsible for:

Creative calendar management
Project prioritization
Creative briefs
Review processes
Resource coordination
Delivery planning
Cross-functional communication

Own creative prioritization and capacity planning across internal teams, freelancers and external partners.

When resources cannot support every request, proactively bring forward recommendations and proposed trade-offs—not just problems—for alignment with Anna.

Protect the quality of output while ensuring the Creative Studio operates efficiently at scale.







08 — Stay Hands-On

We are looking for a creative leader who still loves making things.

You should be comfortable working in:

Adobe Creative Suite
Moodboards
Presentations
Layouts
Visual references
Creative treatments
On-set problem solving

You do not need to execute every asset yourself.

But you must understand the craft deeply enough to elevate every piece of work.







THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You can walk into a room with designers, marketers, photographers, editors, producers, agencies and external partners and speak everyone’s language.

You understand that your role is to protect the brand, elevate execution and create clarity for the entire creative organization.

You have:

Exceptional visual taste
Strong art direction skills
A portfolio showing both concept understanding and execution excellence
Experience leading shoots and visual productions
Experience working with multidisciplinary creative teams
Strong project and creative workflow management skills
The ability to prioritize multiple creative initiatives simultaneously
Experience managing agencies, freelancers or external production partners
A strong understanding of social-first creative
High cultural awareness
Excellent communication and feedback skills
Strong organizational instincts
High attention to detail
The ability to move between thinking and making
Professional proficiency in English and Spanish

Experience in beauty, fashion, lifestyle or culturally driven brands is highly valued.

You can zoom out to understand the brand and zoom in to question a crop, a typeface, a transition or a layout decision.

Most importantly, you know how to take a creative vision, understand its intention, and make sure it is executed at the highest possible standard across every touchpoint—while enabling teams to move faster and more independently.







HOW WE’LL MEASURE SUCCESS

Within your first 6 months:

Creative consistency

Anna’s creative vision is clearly and consistently translated across campaign, social, retail and digital outputs.

Execution quality

The overall standard of visual execution across the team improves noticeably.

Creative autonomy

Day-to-day creative execution can move forward with minimal Creative Director intervention, with teams confidently operating within established creative standards.

Creative Studio effectiveness

The Creative Studio operates with clear priorities, efficient workflows and balanced resource allocation, resulting in fewer bottlenecks and stronger on-time delivery.

Team elevation

Designers and content creatives become more confident in executing the vision independently, while agencies and external partners receive clearer direction and require fewer revision rounds.

Creative Director leverage

Anna spends significantly more time on vision, concepting and innovation rather than execution oversight, creative triage and day-to-day decision making.







APPLICATION

A portfolio will requested to apply to this role. We are particularly interested in seeing examples of:

Art direction and campaign work
Photography and/or video productions
Social-first creative
Brand and visual identity execution
Projects where you translated a creative concept across multiple touchpoints
Your specific role and contribution to each project

title: Productor de Contenido (video + redes sociales)
description:
About the job

Productor de Contenido (video + redes sociales) — Clinova: Híbrido con salidas a grabación · 14,000 MXN – 22,000 MXN brutos según experiencia.
Sobre nosotros Clinova construye herramientas de inteligencia artificial para que los médicos en México dejen de llevarse las notas clínicas a su casa. Somos un equipo muy pequeño en etapa temprana y estamos por abrir nuestra voz en redes: humor de gremio, cero corporativo, hecho para que un médico se ría y etiquete a su colega.
Quién eres Alguien que graba, edita y publica. Que ve un reel y ya sabe por qué funcionó el primer segundo. Que se siente cómodo llegando a un consultorio con un médico que tiene 20 minutos entre pacientes y saliendo de ahí con material que sirve. Que tiene opinión sobre qué publicar, no solo manos para ejecutarlo.
Qué vas a hacer · Producir de punta a punta el contenido en video de Clinova: idea, guion, grabación en sitio, edición, subtitulado y publicación. · Grabar en consultorios, clínicas, eventos médicos y en nuestras propias sesiones — con presencia física en CDMX y área metropolitana. · Crear piezas estáticas: carruseles, memes y gráficos, dentro de un sistema visual ya definido. · Implementar y mantener automatizaciones de redes (respuestas automáticas por DM, programación, reportes). No respondes mensajes uno por uno; construyes el sistema que lo hace. · Sentarte con el fundador en la planeación quincenal de contenido: traer ideas, ganchos y lecturas de métricas. · Mantener ordenado el archivo de material y los proyectos editables.
Lo que buscamos · 2 a 4 años produciendo contenido para marcas o cuentas con audiencia real (agencia, marca propia, freelance — nos da igual el formato). · Portafolio con video vertical: reels, TikToks o shorts. Es el requisito principal; el CV importa poco. · Dominio de Premiere, DaVinci o CapCut, y de Figma o Canva. · Audio y luz decentes con equipo ligero. No necesitas ser director de fotografía; sí necesitas que se escuche bien. · Capacidad de trabajar con poca supervisión y entregar en tiempos cortos. · Base en CDMX y disponibilidad para trasladarte a grabaciones.
Suma puntos · Manejo de ManyChat, Metricool, Buffer, Make o Zapier. · Escribir bien y con humor en español mexicano. · Haber construido una cuenta propia desde cero, del tamaño que sea.
Lo que este puesto NO es No es atención al cliente ni responder mensajes todo el día. No es diseño de identidad de marca. No es compra de medios.
Condiciones · Sueldo de $14,000 a $22,000 MXN brutos mensuales según experiencia, más apoyo de traslados y renta de equipo si trabajas con el tuyo. · Primeros 3 meses por honorarios, con paso a nómina formal (IMSS y prestaciones de ley) a partir del cuarto mes. Te lo decimos claro desde ahora. · Horario flexible con días de grabación agendados con anticipación. · Licencias y herramientas por nuestra cuenta. · Trabajarás directamente con el fundador y tu trabajo será la cara pública de la empresa.
Confidencialidad Trabajamos cerca de médicos y de información sensible. Firmarás un acuerdo de confidencialidad y seguirás reglas estrictas: nunca se graba a un paciente, una pantalla con datos clínicos ni el audio de una consulta.
Cómo postularte Llena este formulario https://forms.gle/uceotW2VVd3kPJSf6. Nos importan tres cosas: (1) el link a tu portafolio o a tu cuenta, (2) un video que hayas hecho completo —grabado y editado por ti— con 3 líneas sobre qué harías distinto hoy, y (3) cómo automatizarías responder 50 mensajes directos idénticos al día. Hay una prueba práctica pagada como parte del proceso. No pedimos trabajo gratis.

About the job

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible. 

You will improve value and service to your customers and improve supply chain efficiency. In addition, you will use internal and customer data to optimize plans and to support joint initiatives with strategic customers.

How You Will Contribute

You will:


Be the single point of contact for your customer portfolio
Manage escalations for complaints and disputes, and handle and resolve issues to ensure maximum customer satisfaction
Help achieve business and commercial objectives by achieving customer service targets, supporting the improvement agenda (internal process and external customer) and developing collaborative relationships cross-functionally and with customers
Work with the order fulfilment team to report on KPIs, including root-cause analysis and improvement initiatives
Use customer data to monitor on-shelf availability, depot-to-store service, stock holding and promotional sales. Use this information to drive decision making internally and with the customer in ways that maximize service levels and sales



What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:


Experience in CS&L and with customers
Experience in fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods company
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
SAP knowledge and expertise in MS Office
Customer orientation, strong influencing and communication skills
Strong focus on delivering productivities, service and KPIs
Team player, accountable, proactive thinking, flexibility



Objective

Lead logistics and customer service collaboration at an advanced and comprehensive level for Grupo Walmart across the Cheese and Crackers categories. The role seeks to maximize supply chain efficiency, optimize commercial value, and drive customer satisfaction through data analysis, replenishment tracking, and the development of high-impact collaborative plans.

Responsibilities

Relationship Management & Strategic Collaboration:

Serve as the single point of contact for the Walmart portfolio.

Design and actively participate in the construction of the AVP (Annual Value Plan) and collaborative plans in partnership with the customer's CPFRs.

Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships at a cross-functional level (internal teams and Walmart's commercial/supply teams).

Operational Tracking & Replenishment Analysis:

Conduct consistent, weekly tracking of replenishments, inventory levels, and performance through Walmart's specific portals.

Monitor and analyze key metrics such as On-Shelf Availability, DC-to-store service, days of stock, and promotional sales to make decisions that maximize sales and service levels.

Work hand-in-hand with the Order Fulfillment team for KPI reporting, root-cause analysis, and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives.

Issue Management & Continuous Improvement:

Map and resolve escalations, disputes, or operational complaints to ensure compliance with service targets and the business's commercial objectives.

Requirements

Experience in Customer Service & Logistics (CS&L) within the FMCG / CPG industry.

Solid, prior experience with Grupo Walmart: Deep knowledge of their replenishment processes, portals, and key logistics metrics.

Advanced proficiency in SAP and MS Office Suite (especially Excel for data analysis).

No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

Mondelez México has been in the country since 1927 and currently employs 6,000 wonderful people. Our diverse portfolio includes iconic and mouth-watering global brands such as Trident, Oreo, Philadelphia, and local jewels like Clorets and Bubbaloo. We are leaders in the making of cream cheese, powdered beverages and confections—in fact, we make seven out of every 10 chewing gums consumed by Mexicans. Our growth is supported by our cutting-edge manufacturing facilities, such as our Puebla Plant and Nuevo León HUB, which are the largest gums, candies and biscuits factories in the world in terms of volume. You can buy are products in 900,000 places in Mexico. We are also home to one of the 11 technology centers Mondelez International has worldwide, a specialized gum and candy facility that places us at the forefront of innovation and development in the country and drives our purpose to lead the future of snacking. We are pioneers in the country in work-life balance practices such as extended maternity leave, open spaces, remote work and flexible working hours.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Regular
