description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over a million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We're going to achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way, and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all of Stripe's growth.

Stripe has unique operational problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with as a result of "growing the GDP of the internet." Stripes leverage their understanding of our products, the financial industry and money movement, and our processes to support both internal and external users. Doing so requires us to invest significant resources into building this experience ourselves.

What you'll do

The role of Ops Associate can be interpreted as a Stripe "athlete" that will engage in either internal-facing or external-facing (e.g., support, risk) workflows, or both. OA roles will be highly operational in nature and will largely be aligned with case-level or process-type work. OAs will work on workflows which are considered to be "medium complexity" or sensitive in nature, therefore requiring internal Stripe-level systems and tools access, meaning that it cannot be outsourced. As the SDC matures and capability is established, we can expect the complexity of work at SDC to increase, and additionally aspire to drive improvements in the work we are responsible for.

Responsibilities


Deliver exceptional Stripe experience by efficiently and accurately resolving issues across social media platforms (e.g., X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and others)
Help resolve issues that are escalated via social media, including technical product questions, and work to prevent those issues from happening again
Partner with internal teams across Stripe (e.g., Comms, Incident Ops, Risk), serving as the ultimate escalation point for high-stakes user issues and proactively initiating incident reports with a user-first mindset
Coordinate executive escalations from Stripe's leaders with other teams
Contribute to and manage new programs focused on improving the Stripe user experience
Identify operational process gaps and initiate continuous improvements to accelerate global scale while delivering an exceptional experience for Stripe users
Be part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have experience with social media support or an interest in resolving user issues through those channels (e.g., Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook).
You have prior experience in customer support and external user-facing operations.
You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems, leveraging a process-oriented approach and a curiosity for technical products.
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving.
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done.
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support.
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment.
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners.
You're willing to work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off in lieu. The CDMX Operations team operates during daytime hours in 9-hour shifts (including 1-hour paid lunch break) scheduled to fall between the hours of 6am and 10pm.



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives
Prior experience or technical proficiency with Sprinklr will be an added advantage.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

About the job

About Us

SimplePractice is headquartered in Los Angeles, California, but we have team members who work and live across the United States, Dominican Republic, Mexico City, and Ukraine.



At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice. 



More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients. 



Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. In 2026, we were recognized by BuiltIn as a Best Remote Company to Work For, Software Guru's Best Places to Code, Becker Healthcare Telehealth Companies to Know, and we won a MedTech Breakthrough Award for Best Practice Management Solution Provider.

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Data Transfer Associate to join our Customer Success team with a focus on our foundational data operations. In this role, you are the facilitator of first impressions and data accuracy. You will be responsible for managing the initial stages of the data migration journey, ensuring that customers feel supported from their very first interaction while maintaining the integrity of our most straight-forward data transfers.



As a Data Transfer Associate, you handle the essential "first-touch" communications and process standard datasets—from clinical workflows to basic demographics. You will serve as a foundational partner within the team, ensuring the high-volume, core data work that keeps



SimplePractice running smoothly is executed with precision.

What sets Data Transfer Associate apart?

● Foundational Execution: You focus on the core "Doing" of the data transfer process: processing, supporting, and coordinating essential transfers.



● First-Touch Ownership: You act as the initial point of contact for customers beginning their data move, setting the tone for a professional and seamless onboarding experience.



● Technical Learning: You are in a "Learning" phase, utilizing reference materials and team resources to master data cleansing and system requirements.



● Quality Review: You perform basic data reviews and transformations, ensuring that standard files are formatted correctly before they enter the system.

What would you do for us?



Core Data Operations (90%)



● First-Touch Communication: Send professional, empathetic first-touch responses to customers to kick off their data transfer process and set clear expectations.



● Process Standard Transfers: Execute straight-forward data migrations from spreadsheets and CSVs, ensuring data is mapped accurately to SimplePractice requirements.



● Basic Data Review: Review incoming customer datasets for common errors, performing essential cleansing (trimming, formatting, and organization) to prepare files for import.



● Administrative Support: Assist in coordinating the transfer queue, ensuring that standard tasks are moved forward and deadlines are met.



● Compliance Adherence: Follow all regulations and policies around HIPAA, PHI, and PII with diligent attention to detail.



Learning & Development (10%)



● Skill Building: Focus on developing competency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and basic SQL under the guidance of a Team Lead or Specialist II.



● Knowledge Base Engagement: Utilize and contribute to team macros and internal documentation as you learn the SimplePractice product and common workflows.



● Team Participation: Participate in team meetings and shadow more complex "Group" migrations to prepare for future growth into the Specialist track.



Data Transfer Associate Must-Haves:



● Experience: Limited to no previous professional experience; some roles may require a specific educational background or degree.



● Technical Foundation: Familiarity with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets (e.g., you can perform basic data organization and understand simple formulas).



● Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy when reviewing data and a commitment to maintaining data integrity.



● Communication Skills: Confident and sensitive communication style, suitable for being the "first touch" for our customers.



● Personal Accountability: Ability to manage assigned tasks and deadlines with a proactive and coachable mindset.

Preferred

● Prior experience in a customer-facing or administrative role.



● Familiarity with SimplePractice or healthcare software workflows.

skills: CS Lifecycle Process Design & Governance: Du definierst und steuerst standardisierte CS-Workflows über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus (Onboarding, Adoption, Value Realisation, Renewal, Eskalation und Expansion), baust CS-Playbooks auf und sorgst gemeinsam mit der CS-Führung für eine konsequente Prozessadoption.

Customer Health & Insights: Du verantwortest das Customer Health Scoring in Zusammenarbeit mit Analytics/Planning, überwachst Frühwarnindikatoren für Churn und Risiken und stellst sicher, dass das CS-Team jederzeit proaktiv und datenbasiert handeln kann.

CSM Tool Evaluation & Platform Ownership: Du leitest die strukturierte Evaluierung und Auswahl einer neuen CSM-Plattform (z.B. Gainsight, ChurnZero, Totango), verantwortest die fachseitige Konfiguration inklusive Workflows, Alerts und Health Score Logik und koordinierst zuverlässige Integrationen mit CRM und Produktnutzungsdaten.

Erfahrung & fachliche Basis: Du bringst 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations oder CS-Programmoperations mit und verfügst über ein fundiertes Verständnis von Retention-Treibern, Adoption-Signalen, Churn-Risiken und Renewal-Prozessen.

Workation eröffnet dir neue Möglichkeiten: Arbeite für bis zu zwei Monate im Ausland und verlängere so deine Zeit in der Ferne oder die Ferien bei Freunden und Familie.

Nachhaltig gedacht: Wir unterstützen dich in puncto Gesundheit und Altersvorsorge mit umfassenden Sozialleistungen und einer Vielzahl an Mobilität-Angeboten, wie etwa einem Job-Rad oder Job-Ticket für den ÖPNV.

description:
About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico's Total Consumer Electronics is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As a Brand Specialist, you'll own selected brands to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You'll be responsible for looking after the brands' portfolio, contributing to improvements in the experience for customers and creating weekly reports on performance. You'll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors, acting as main point of contact for them.

You will provide support to drive business growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

To achieve success in this role, you will have strong analytical and relationship management skills. You are comfortable picking up new technologies and skills quickly. You'll be a problem solver, identifying issues or opportunity areas to then create plans to drive improvement.

As a Brand Specialist, You Will Be Fully Involved In All Business Functions Of Your Brands, Including Onsite Marketing, Vendor Relation Management And In-stock Management. Some Of The Tasks Associated With These Functions Include

Online marketing: improve product page data, develop marketing and merchandising plans, improve experience onsite, generate traffic and sales; Vendor management: grow catalog to sell on Amazon, identify and resolve pricing issues; In-stock management: tracking purchase orders and work with vendors automation.

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in process improvement
 Experience managing large amounts of data


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. This role serves as the strategic analytics lead for a portfolio of B2B marketing campaigns, connecting data from paid media, organic social, earned media, AI search/GEO, website performance, and CRM systems into a unified view of what's working and why. Rather than focusing on report production, the primary mandate is to interpret campaign and funnel data, identify meaningful trends and optimization opportunities, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations. The person in this role will build and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks, but their core value lies in explaining performance to marketing and executive stakeholders and guiding data-informed decisions. Strong client-facing communication is essential, as this role regularly presents insights and recommendations directly to stakeholders across multiple accounts.

Competitive salary in USD

PTO and paid U.S. holidays

Consolidate and analyze performance data across paid media (Meta, LinkedIn, Google Ads, programmatic, content syndication), organic social, earned media/PR, AI search/GEO, website analytics, and CRM/funnel data into a cohesive view of campaign and business performance.

description:
About the job

About Duzer Group




Duzer Group is a U.S.-based medical marketing agency specializing in helping vein and vascular clinics grow.




We combine extensive medical marketing experience with firsthand experience operating and growing clinics ourselves. Our team has helped medical practices increase patient volume, grow revenue, and build more predictable patient acquisition systems.




We are hiring a full-time Business Development Representative (BDR) to help us identify, research, and build relationships with vein and vascular practices throughout the United States.




This is not a traditional high-volume call-center position. We are looking for someone who can research prospective practices, identify the right decision-makers, execute thoughtful personalized outreach, and consistently follow up to create qualified sales opportunities.




What You'll Do




Research vein and vascular clinics throughout the United States
Identify physicians, practice owners, practice managers, and other relevant decision-makers
Research each practice, its services, locations, marketing presence, and potential opportunities
Prepare prospect research our team can use to create highly personalized outreach
Execute personalized outreach through email, LinkedIn, and other channels
Make targeted outbound calls and follow-up calls when appropriate
Professionally navigate receptionists and gatekeepers
Build relationships with prospects rather than relying solely on one-time cold outreach
Maintain consistent follow-up with prospective clients over longer sales cycles
Schedule qualified meetings with our sales team
Maintain accurate records of outreach, conversations, objections, and next steps in our CRM
Ensure promising prospects never fall through the cracks
Test different outreach messages and approaches with our team
Track outreach activity, responses, meetings, and results




What We're Looking For




We are looking for someone with strong B2B prospecting and business development experience, but also someone who can think critically, research effectively, and communicate professionally.




The ideal candidate has:




2+ years of B2B business development, outbound sales, prospecting, or appointment-setting experience
Experience prospecting U.S. businesses and decision-makers
Excellent spoken and written English
Strong online research skills
Professional and confident communication skills
Experience identifying and reaching business owners or senior decision-makers
Strong email and written outreach skills
Comfort making outbound calls and speaking with cold prospects
Ability to navigate gatekeepers professionally
Experience with LinkedIn prospecting and/or social selling
Strong follow-up discipline
Experience using CRM and sales prospecting tools
Excellent organization and attention to detail
Ability to work independently and remain productive in a remote environment
Availability during U.S. business hours




Experience working with healthcare, medical practices, physicians, marketing agencies, or other professional B2B services is strongly preferred.


This Role May Be a Great Fit If...




You enjoy figuring out how to get the attention of a difficult-to-reach prospect, rather than simply making as many calls as possible.




You are comfortable researching a company before contacting it, finding a relevant reason to reach out, personalizing your communication, and following up consistently.




You understand that effective business development requires persistence while still representing the company professionally and building positive relationships with prospects.


How You'll Be Measured




This is a performance-driven position, but success is not measured simply by the number of calls made.




We will look at:




Quality target accounts researched
Decision-makers identified
Personalized outreach completed
Prospect response and conversation rates
Follow-up consistency
CRM accuracy
Qualified meetings held
Sales opportunities created
New clients generated from your outreach




Our goal is to create qualified new-business opportunities while representing Duzer Group professionally within the medical industry.


What Counts as a Qualified Meeting?




A meeting only qualifies for a performance bonus when:




The practice meets Duzer Group's target criteria
The meeting is with an appropriate decision-maker, such as a physician, owner, or qualified practice manager
The prospect understands the purpose of the conversation and has genuine interest in discussing growth or marketing
The prospect is not an existing Duzer Group client or active opportunity
The prospect actually attends the scheduled meeting




We reward qualified meetings that are held, not simply appointments placed on a calendar.


Compensation




MX$26,000–MX$34,000/month base, depending on experience
Performance bonus for each qualified meeting held
Additional bonus for each new client generated from your outreach
Uncapped performance-based earning potential




For an exceptional candidate, we are prepared to offer a highly competitive compensation package based on experience and demonstrated ability.


Schedule




Full-time
Monday–Friday
Remote
Must be available during agreed-upon U.S. business hours




This is intended to be a long-term position, not a temporary project or side job.


Work Requirements




You must have:




Reliable computer
High-quality headset
Quiet, professional workspace
Fast and stable internet connection
Backup internet option
Ability to participate in video meetings and make professional calls without background noise or interruptions

How to Apply




Please submit your resume and briefly answer the following questions:




How many years of B2B business development, outbound sales, or prospecting experience do you have?
What types of U.S. businesses and decision-makers have you previously prospected?
Briefly describe how you would research a company before reaching out to a decision-maker.
Which outbound channels and sales tools have you used? Please include experience with phone, email, LinkedIn, CRM, prospecting platforms, or other relevant tools.
In your most recent relevant role, approximately how many qualified sales meetings were you generating per month, and what counted as a qualified meeting?
Are you available to work full-time with substantial overlap with U.S. business hours? Are you currently working for any other companies or clients? If yes, please describe your current commitments.

Who Will Succeed in This Role




We're not looking for someone who simply wants a remote job or someone who believes business development means sending hundreds of generic messages.

We're looking for someone who is curious, resourceful, persistent, organized, and commercially minded.




If you know how to research a prospect, find the right person, develop a relevant reason to contact them, communicate professionally, and follow up consistently until an opportunity is created, we'd like to hear from you.

About the job

Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $607,000 - $789,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $607,000 - $744,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

Remote, Mexico / LatAm

Why this role is remarkable


Join an official TikTok Partner driving $20M+ in monthly GMV, placing you at the forefront of the global social commerce revolution.

Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote role within LatAm while collaborating directly with founders to scale a rapidly expanding creator roster.


What You Will Do

Coordinate the end-to-end Creator Affiliate Program (CAP) workflow, including offer intake, product seeding, and tracking video output across high-volume campaigns.
Analyze performance metrics and GMV trends to provide weekly reports and flag high-potential creators for priority brand partnerships.


The ideal candidate


Has 1–2+ years of experience in influencer marketing, talent coordination, or TikTok Shop operations, preferably within a high-volume performance environment.
Possesses exceptional written English skills and professional communication habits, capable of managing hundreds of creator interactions via email and WhatsApp.
Demonstrates proficiency in Google Sheets, CRM tools like Salesforce, and project management software such as Monday.com or Lark to track complex workflows.


Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?


Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

About the job

🚀 We’re Hiring: HubSpot Solutions Architect (Technical Lead)




Most HubSpot agencies do standard implementations. We do the heavy lifting. We don't just set up pipelines; we engineer complex migrations, architect multi-system custom integrations, and build hyper-personalized data experiences.




As our HubSpot Solutions Architect, you will be the technical mastermind behind our most complex client projects. Project Leadership: Act as the ultimate technical safety net for the delivery team, ensuring that what we architect is exactly what gets built and deployed.




What You Bring to the Table




Proven Experience: 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience architecting and configuring complex solutions within the HubSpot ecosystem.

Deep HubSpot Expertise: You know the ecosystem inside and out, including Sales, Marketing, Service, CMS, and Operations Hub.
Client-Facing Confidence: You are highly comfortable leading technical workshops, challenging assumptions, and explaining complex backend concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Agency Agility: You thrive in a fast-paced, multi-client environment and know how to manage competing technical priorities effectively.
Certifications: You hold advanced HubSpot certifications (Solutions Architecture, Data Integration, etc.).

title: Fleet Acquisition Specialist
description:
About the job

En PartRunner conectamos a las empresas que mueven mercancía de gran volumen con la capacidad de transporte que lo hace posible. Nuestra red integra flotas PyME y transportistas independientes en distintos puntos de México, con unidades que van desde vehículos ligeros hasta carga pesada.




Para seguir creciendo necesitamos algo fundamental: más capacidad en los mercados correctos. Hoy esos mercados son León-Querétaro, Puebla y Monterrey.

Por eso buscamos un/a Fleet Acquisition Specialist que viva en alguna de estas plazas y expanda nuestra red de transportistas desde ahí. Identificarás flotas y hombres-camión, negociarás condiciones y cerrarás afiliaciones, hasta lograr que cada unidad pase de ser una oportunidad comercial a capacidad activa dentro de PartRunner.




Es un rol 100% remoto y con ownership end to end. Construyes tu propio pipeline, lo trabajas y respondes por él hasta que las unidades están rodando.




Lo que harás

1. Prospección y Generación de Pipeline

Prospectar y reclutar hombres-camión y flotas PyME en distintos estados de México.

Ejecutar estrategias de prospección digital enfocadas en fletes: redes sociales, bases de datos, campañas y marketplaces del sector.

Construir y mantener tu propio pipeline en CRM, con seguimiento disciplinado por etapa.

Identificar y abrir nuevas fuentes de captación, no solo trabajar las existentes.




2. Negociación y Cierre de Afiliaciones

Negociar condiciones comerciales con transportistas y flotas, equilibrando competitividad y rentabilidad para el negocio.

Cerrar afiliaciones y asegurar la firma de las condiciones acordadas.

Gestionar objeciones de fondo: tarifas, tiempos de pago, garantías, volumen comprometido.

Trabajo en campo cuando acelere cierres estratégicos.




3. Activación y Onboarding de Unidades

Dar seguimiento puntual al proceso de onboarding dentro de la plataforma hasta la activación real de cada unidad.

Asegurar que la documentación y los requisitos de alta estén completos y en tiempo.

Reducir el tiempo entre cierre y primer viaje.




4. Relación con Transportistas y Retención

Mantener comunicación constante con proveedores vía WhatsApp, llamadas, correo y reuniones presenciales.

Detectar señales tempranas de churn y actuar antes de perder la unidad.

Ser el punto de contacto comercial de las flotas que traes a la red.

Levantar hacia el equipo interno lo que la red necesita para quedarse.




5. Enfoque Analítico y Estrategia de Crecimiento

Cumplir KPIs comerciales semanales y mensuales de adquisición, activación y retención.

Analizar métricas de desempeño para optimizar tasas de conversión y retención por estado, tipo de unidad y canal de captación.

Desarrollar estrategias para ampliar la red en mercados con déficit de capacidad.

Coordinar con Marketing para impulsar campañas de captación y aportar el input de campo que las haga funcionar.




Lo que necesitamos de ti

Must Have

2+ años de experiencia en adquisición, onboarding o ventas.

2+ años en industria de transporte, logística, paquetería o marketplaces digitales.

Experiencia comprobable en ventas y negociación, con números que la respalden.

Manejo de CRM y seguimiento estructurado de pipeline comercial.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y cierre.




Nice to Have

Experiencia en prospección digital de fletes.

Experiencia previa en startups.

Experiencia en trabajo de campo con transportistas.




Competencias Clave

Tienes pensamiento crítico: cuestionas el proceso cuando no está siendo funcional y propones mejoras.

Organización y capacidad de multitarea real, con varias negociaciones abiertas a la vez.

Curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA, y las usas para hacer más con menos.




Nuestra oferta de valor

Sueldo base competitivo + prestaciones de ley y superiores + esquema 100% remoto




¿Listo/a para el reto?

Envía tu CV a f.castillo@partrunner.com o postúlate directamente por este medio.




En PartRunner promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y libre de discriminación. Todas las decisiones de nuestros procesos se basan en competencias, experiencia y potencial, sin distinción de género, edad, origen, orientación, identidad o cualquier otra condición.

title: Partnerships & Growth Manager
description:
About the job

About Zipmi 

Zipmi is reimagining the US visa application experience. Our flagship product guides applicants through the DS-160 — the required nonimmigrant visa form — making a notoriously complex government process fast, accurate, and stress-free. We're a fast-moving team building at the intersection of immigration, technology, and global mobility.




The Role 

We're looking for a Partnerships & Growth Manager to build and own Zipmi's external partnership ecosystem. This is a foundational role — you'll be the first person dedicated to partnerships at Zipmi, which means you'll be building the playbook from scratch.

Your focus will be split across two tracks: forging relationships with government-adjacent organizations and institutions that serve visa applicants, and identifying brand and commercial partners who can drive distribution and trust at scale.

This role sits at the intersection of business development, marketing, and strategy. It's ideal for someone who is equally comfortable in a government affairs meeting and a startup pitch room. You will work closely with our marketing team, building critical relationships in our go-to-market strategy across Brazil and Mexico. 


What You'll Do 

Government & Institutional Partnerships

• Identify and build relationships with US embassies, consulates, and State Department-adjacent organizations that interact with visa applicants

• Partner with international student offices at universities and colleges to position Zipmi as a recommended resource for F-1 and J-1 applicants

• Develop relationships with immigration attorneys, law firms, and accredited representatives who advise DS-160 applicants

• Engage with foreign government tourism and trade offices, expat organizations, and international chambers of commerce

• Navigate compliance and regulatory considerations to ensure all partnerships meet legal and ethical standards

Brand & Commercial Partnerships

• Identify and close partnerships with travel brands, airlines, hospitality/resort brands, international relocation companies, and HR/mobility platforms whose customers overlap with visa applicants

• Build co-marketing programs that put Zipmi in front of applicants at the moment they need it most

• Develop affiliate and referral structures that create scalable, measurable distribution

• Work with employers and HR teams who sponsor international workers and support visa applications as part of the relocation process

Strategy & Operations

• Own the full partnership lifecycle from prospecting and outreach through negotiation, contracting, and ongoing relationship management

• Build and maintain a partnership pipeline and report regularly on activity, conversion, and revenue impact

• Collaborate with the product and marketing teams to develop partner-facing materials, co-branded content, and integration workflows

• Represent Zipmi at relevant industry conferences, immigration events, and trade shows




What We're Looking For 

• 4–7 years of experience in partnerships, business development, or growth — ideally at a startup or in a regulated industry

• Proven track record of building partnerships from scratch and closing deals with both institutional and commercial partners

• Comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder relationships — particularly with government or quasi-government organizations

• Strong communicator and relationship builder — you can tailor your pitch to a university administrator, a consulate official, and a CMO in the same week

• Self-starter who thrives with ambiguity and can build structure where none exists

• Experience in immigration, legaltech, fintech, or government services is a strong plus

• Existing relationships in the immigration, education, hospitality and global mobility space are a significant advantage




What You'll Get 

• The opportunity to build and own an entirely new function at a company tackling a massive, underserved market

• Competitive salary 

• Remote-friendly culture with a team that moves fast and takes ownership seriously

title: Closer de Ventas B2B High-Ticket — Tecnología HIFU | Remoto | $3,200–$6,400 USD/mes en inbound + 10% outbound
description:
About the job

¿Sabes conducir una videollamada comercial, descubrir la necesidad real de un negocio y convertir una oportunidad de alto valor en una venta?




En Ultrasonic ampliamos nuestro equipo comercial internacional. Buscamos un/a Closer de Ventas B2B High-Ticket con experiencia real en cierre consultivo para trabajar con clínicas estéticas, centros de belleza y spas médicos en España, México y Estados Unidos.

No vendemos cursos ni servicios abstractos. Comercializamos Ultrasonic 12D, una plataforma de tecnología HIFU para tratamientos médico-estéticos de alto valor, dentro de un modelo llave en mano que combina tecnología, formación para el cliente y marketing para impulsar la demanda.

Tu misión es clara: recibir oportunidades comerciales reales, entender el negocio del prospecto, presentar la solución, construir una propuesta a medida y convertir la conversación en una venta cobrada.


Lo que hace diferente esta posición

Recibirás leads reales procedentes de campañas de marketing activas. Ultrasonic invierte en captación digital, retargeting y generación de demanda. No empiezas con una lista fría sin contexto: trabajas oportunidades que ya han mostrado interés y que necesitan una conversación comercial profesional para avanzar.

Tendrás un equipo de Setters profesionales agendando reuniones calificadas para ti. El equipo de setting identifica necesidad, valida información clave, nutre al prospecto con los materiales necesarios y confirma la asistencia antes de transferirte la reunión. Tu foco está donde aporta más valor: diagnosticar, presentar, resolver objeciones y cerrar.

Tu trabajo es procesar y convertir oportunidades en venta. No buscamos a alguien que haga presentaciones genéricas o deje propuestas sin seguimiento. Buscamos un Closer que domine la conversación de negocio, demuestre el retorno de inversión con los números del propio cliente y lleve cada oportunidad a una decisión concreta.

Tendrás onboarding, academia y dirección comercial. Recibirás configuración de CRM y herramientas, acceso a la academia de producto, dossier comercial, casos reales, configurador de propuestas, scripts, roleplays y sesiones de coaching con Dirección Comercial. El acceso a reuniones reales llega cuando demuestras en roleplay que puedes ejecutar el método, no cuando simplemente han pasado unos días.


Un sistema de comisiones diseñado para premiar el cierre

Es una posición 100% a comisión, sin salario base y sin techo artificial de ingresos. La lógica es directa: cuanto mejor cierras, más te beneficia el sistema.

En operaciones inbound, las primeras cuatro ventas del mes generan una comisión del 5%. Al cerrar la quinta venta, la comisión sube al 8% y se recalcula de forma retroactiva sobre todas las ventas inbound de ese mes. Con un ticket medio de referencia de $8,000 USD, cuatro ventas representan $1,600 USD; cinco ventas activan $3,200 USD; siete ventas equivalen a $4,480 USD y diez ventas a $6,400 USD.

Si generas tus propias oportunidades mediante prospección outbound, cobras un 10% flat por cada operación cerrada. Con cinco ventas inbound y dos operaciones outbound, el escenario de referencia alcanza $4,800 USD en comisiones.

El detalle completo del sistema, los requisitos de validación, la atribución de ventas, los objetivos y las condiciones operativas se muestra en la web antes de que tomes ninguna decisión.


El perfil que buscamos

Buscamos una persona con al menos un año de experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B, high-ticket, tecnología, salud, estética o entornos consultivos. Debe saber conducir una videollamada profesional, escuchar antes de presentar, usar un CRM con disciplina y manejar objeciones sin necesidad de improvisar promesas imposibles.

Necesitas español nativo o nivel profesional, ordenador propio, conexión estable, cámara y disposición para grabar reuniones como parte del proceso de calidad y coaching. El inglés es un plus para oportunidades en Estados Unidos. La relación es mercantil, por lo que debes poder emitir factura como autónomo/a, freelance o empresa.

Valoramos especialmente a quien sabe vender retorno, no descuento. Si entiendes que una clínica no compra una máquina sino una nueva línea de facturación, vas a entender muy rápido la propuesta de Ultrasonic.


Proceso de selección

El proceso es directo: registro en la web, vídeo de presentación, vídeo pitch de producto, entrevista por videollamada con roleplay, propuesta de incorporación y onboarding.

¿Te interesa cerrar ventas de alto valor con producto real, campañas activas, reuniones calificadas y un sistema de comisiones que escala a tu favor?




Haz clic en “Solicitar empleo”. Accederás a la web con toda la información detallada del puesto, el modelo de comisiones, el proceso y el formulario de registro:

https://ventas.ultrasonic-pro.com

Hay oportunidades comerciales activas. Incorporación según proceso de selección.

Ultrasonic — Blink Professional Studio S.L.
